exposure: integrated Family-Centered Care (FCC) and Developmental Care (DC)
cohort: The study included 200 high-risk neonates (<32 weeks gestation or <1500 g) admitted to neonatal intensive care units.
finding: Integrating FCC and DC in neonatal care significantly enhanced neurodevelopmental outcomes (cognitive, motor, language scores) and reduced the length of hospitalization for high-risk neonates compared to standard care.
